title: 도시재정비 촉진을 위한 특별법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00006:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 1, March 23, 2013>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation. <Proviso omitted>

Articles 2 through 5 Omitted.

Article 6 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (49) Omitted.

(50) Part of the Enforcement Rules of the Special Act on the Promotion of Urban Renewal shall be amended as follows:

In Articles 2, 3, and 5, "Minister of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport" in each case.

In the former part of Article 4, "Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Transport and Maritime Affairs" shall be replaced with "Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport".

(51) through (126) Omitted.
